context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

When should the skill ask the user whether they or the agent will run the application, and how should that question be phrased?

checklist.name: asked-at-start-of-run
checklist.description: Places the question after Instrument, at the start of Run, asked with one structured question (the agent's own question tool when it has one, else a short numbered list) that explains the app has to run once to send spans, offering "I run it" and "You run it".

checklist.name: not-in-assess-skipped-when-answered
checklist.description: States that it is not one of the four Assess questions, and that it is skipped when the user already said who runs the app.

checklist.name: no-early-or-table-form
checklist.description: Does not ask it first thing or render it as a row of the Assess question table. FAIL if it does either.
